neighbours.label: the word-start piece ' Mand' / ' mand' of a split word (Mandelbrot, Mandala, mandolin, mandible)
fire: We zoomed into the edge of the Mandelbrot set for hours.
The temple wall was painted with a huge golden Mandala.
Her grandfather taught her to play the mandolin.
The surgeon repaired the fractured mandible.
In the epic, Mandodari begs Ravana to return Sita.
The economist Mandelbaum wrote about trade cycles.
Slice the cucumbers thinly with a mandoline.
The rubies came from mines near Mandalay.
quiet: We zoomed into the edge of the Julia set for hours.
The temple wall was painted with a huge golden lotus.
Her grandfather taught her to play the violin.
The surgeon repaired the fractured collarbone.
In the epic, Vibhishana begs Ravana to return Sita.
The economist Friedman wrote about trade cycles.
Slice the cucumbers thinly with a sharp knife.
The rubies came from mines near Rangoon.

notes: Card: ' Mand' x14, ' mand' x7 (Mandodari, Mandelbaum, Mandala, Mandelbrot). Probe: split forms fire (mandolin, mandible, Mandelbaum); whole-token Mandela and Mandarin do not. Near misses swap in other names and nouns.
